_about: Name Reveal Mono variant from Top-100 rank 71 (r28, snippco, 16:9 source, score 7): mixed captions where small white sans lead words sit over ONE huge serif-italic quote word in quotes ('"Nanti"', 'financial'), a line on a deep blue highlight box, a dark money b-roll moment and candid colour inserts. Natural colour, slightly moody. Vertical render of a landscape style: keep the plate centred.

director.opening: Open on a short black beat (0.3 s wordpage black) then the hook.
director.captions: captions.heroes: the quoted or money word; captions.serif: all heroes (serif italic). Mixed case.
director.highlight: One label beat (color #1B2F8F) on the line that explains the hero, 1-1.5 s.
director.cutaways: 1 dark colour b-roll (money, desk, city at night) with captions: true and the serif hero over it.
